summary: All 51 requirements implemented in 15 Java files; 9 points the requirements did not settle are recorded below.

issues.title: '-1 means none' for cstc/cdyn conflicts with their natural-number type
issues.raw: LRE-Var5/Var6 declare cstc and cdyn natural numbers yet say -1 means no obstacle; LRE-DM5/OP3/OP4 say closestStaticIndex()/closestDynamicIndex() return -1. A nat cannot hold -1 and the profile forbids negative sentinels.
issues.fix_directive: Resolved: obstacle indices start at 1 and index 0 (ObstacleRegister.NO_INDEX) means none; put() rejects index 0. The distance functions and field accessors treat 0 like any absent index (large distance, zero fields).

issues.title: Value of the 'safe large distance'
issues.raw: LRE-DM5/OP2/OP5 require a safe large distance when no obstacle exists but give no value.
issues.fix_directive: Chose 100000.0 m (private constant SAFE_LARGE_DIST in Sensor), returned by hdist, vdist and odist for an absent index.

issues.title: CPA formula: horizontal plane, closing velocity, regularised denominator
issues.raw: LRE-OP5 names cda and tcpa but no formula. Only horizontal relative position/velocity accessors exist; DM5 field accessors return 0 for no obstacle while OP5 expects large-distance defaults.
issues.fix_directive: tcpa = (p.c)/(|c|^2+0.001), cda = sqrt(hdist(i)^2 - tcpa^2(|c|^2+0.001)), with p = (nsRelDist, ewRelDist), c = AUV velocity - obstacle velocity. Using hdist for |p| makes cda the large distance and tcpa 0 when there is no dynamic obstacle; 0.001 avoids 0/0 for zero relative velocity (it is a literal, not a guard constant).

issues.title: CheckOPEZ and CalcCPA read the closest index from the sensor directly
issues.raw: LRE-OP2/OP5 say CheckOPEZ uses the index computed by CalcCStc and CalcCPA the one from CalcCDyn; the profile lets an operation's compute() use only sensor calls, constants and its own fields.
issues.fix_directive: Both call sensor.closestStaticIndex()/closestDynamicIndex(), the same function CalcCStc/CalcCDyn call in the same step, so the value is identical.

issues.title: Transition priority within each mode
issues.raw: The requirements give no priority between transitions leaving the same mode.
issues.fix_directive: In MOM, HCM and CAM the guard-only (autonomous) transitions come first, then the event-triggered ones, because RoboChart has no event-absence guard and an event branch above a guard-only one would leave both enabled. MOM: inOpez, collision risk, Beh9, Beh11, Beh10, then reqOCM, endTask, reqHCM; HCM: inOpez, collision risk, Beh13, then reqOCM; CAM: Beh18 (cda >= minSafeDist), then reqOCM. Each later branch conjoins the negations of the earlier guard-only guards, so safety transitions take precedence over operator requests. Beh11 precedes Beh10: with staticObsVertDist = staticObsDfltVertDist the reverse order would make Beh11 unreachable.

issues.title: Sign of vvel in the vertical-velocity hazard
issues.raw: LRE-Beh11: vvel at or above 1 m/s; vvel is the signed rate of climb (LRE-OP1).
issues.fix_directive: Implemented literally (vvel >= 1.0): fast descent does not trigger Beh11. Beh10 still applies regardless of velocity.

issues.title: Literal thresholds in Beh4 and HCM advised velocity
issues.raw: LRE-Beh4 states vel <= 1 and odist > 1 as literals, not minSafeDist. The system description gives HCM 0.1 m/s; LRE-FR3 says advise 0 m/s on entering HCM.
issues.fix_directive: Used the literal 1.0 in Beh4 (equal to minSafeDist's default) and advVel(0.0) on HCM entry, following the requirements over the description.

issues.title: CAM evasive manoeuvre has no specified output
issues.raw: LRE-FR4: in CAM the AUV performs evasive manoeuvres; no requirement gives an advised velocity or heading for it.
issues.fix_directive: No action on entering CAM; the manoeuvre is outside the LRE's specified outputs.

issues.title: Inputs a mode does not handle are ignored; step(null) means no input
issues.raw: LRE-Beh19/DC1: only the listed transitions exist; reqVel/reqHdng are overridden outside OCM.
issues.fix_directive: No self-loops were added for unhandled events; step(null) runs a cycle with only autonomous transitions.

next_step: Run the pipeline; revisit these choices only if a verifier or reviewer objects.
